units: <cite ref="Chullin 116b:16">Ḥull. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>חלב … פ׳ בעלמא הוא</he> the milk in the stomach of a suckling animal is considered a mere secretion (no longer real milk).
<cite ref="Bekhorot 7b:12">Bekh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ בעלמא הוא</he> it is a mere secretion (a false membrane, no real skin); a. e.—Pl. <he>פַּירְשַׁיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="Q00347"><he>פִּרְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 85a:15">Zeb. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>ניקרבינהו בפִרְשַׁיְיהוּ</he> shall the entrails be offered with the excrements in them?
